component.name: Mac n Droid
component.summary: Your Android phone and your computer, together

description.p: Mac n Droid connects your Android phone to your computer over your own Wi-Fi, with no account and no cloud. Everything is end-to-end encrypted.

ul.li: See your phone's notifications and reply to them, and answer or decline calls
Read and send text messages from your computer
See and use your phone's screen on your computer
Copy on one device and paste on the other, with a shared clipboard history
Send files, photos and folders both ways
Open links from your phone on your computer, and the other way around
Control music playing on your phone from your computer, and the other way around
See your phone's battery, ring it to find it, and get an alert if you leave it behind
